en.title: After legs · gentle mobility
en.summary: A short optional movement break with four easy exercises. Copy it to your programs, review the notes and adjust before starting.
en.author: Kinra
en.progression: Repeat this short session when it fits your schedule. Keep the movements easy and the range comfortable; this is not a load-progression program. Skip any movement that does not suit you rather than pushing through symptoms.
en.considerations: Original general adult movement example. Adapt or skip after a hard workout; stop for pain, dizziness or feeling unwell. It does not prevent soreness, treat injury or replace an individual rehabilitation plan. Counts are movements, breaths or roller passes, not seconds; no duration is logged automatically.

exercises.name: Wall Ankle Mobilization (Mobilizacija gležnja uz zid)
exercises.notes: One rep means one slow out-and-back movement, on each side where relevant. Use a small comfortable range, pause as needed and keep breathing; do not turn this into a forced stretch or timed hold.

exercises.name: Adductor Rock Back (Ljuljanje u adduktor stretch)
exercises.notes: One rep means one slow out-and-back movement, on each side where relevant. Use a small comfortable range, pause as needed and keep breathing; do not turn this into a forced stretch or timed hold.

exercises.name: Hip 90/90 (Devedeset-devedeset pozicija kuka)
exercises.notes: One rep means one slow out-and-back movement, on each side where relevant. Use a small comfortable range, pause as needed and keep breathing; do not turn this into a forced stretch or timed hold.

exercises.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing (Dijafragmalno disanje)
exercises.notes: Count one relaxed inhale and exhale as one rep. Breathe normally without breath holding or forcing a depth or rhythm; stop if light-headed. This records breaths, not a timed breathing session.

bs.title: Nakon nogu · lagana mobilnost
bs.summary: Kratka opcionalna pauza za kretanje s četiri lagane vježbe. Kopirajte u programe, pregledajte napomene i prilagodite prije početka.
bs.goal: Lagana mobilnost i pokreti za oporavak
bs.author: Kinra
bs.progression: Ponovite kratku sesiju kada vam odgovara. Pokreti ostaju lagani i u udobnom rasponu; ovo nije program povećanja tereta. Preskočite pokret koji vam ne odgovara umjesto rada kroz simptome.
bs.considerations: Originalni opšti primjer kretanja za odrasle. Prilagodite ili preskočite nakon teškog treninga; stanite pri bolu, vrtoglavici ili slabosti. Ne sprečava upalu mišića, ne liječi povredu i ne zamjenjuje individualni rehabilitacijski plan. Brojevi su pokreti, udasi ili prolazi valjkom, ne sekunde; trajanje se ne bilježi automatski.

de.title: Nach dem Beintraining · sanfte Mobilität
de.summary: Eine kurze optionale Bewegungspause mit vier leichten Übungen. Kopiere sie in deine Programme, prüfe die Hinweise und passe sie vor dem Start an.
de.author: Kinra
de.progression: Wiederhole die kurze Einheit passend zu deinem Alltag. Halte die Bewegungen leicht und angenehm; dies ist kein Programm zur Laststeigerung. Lasse unpassende Bewegungen aus, statt durch Beschwerden zu trainieren.
de.considerations: Eigenes allgemeines Bewegungsbeispiel für Erwachsene. Passe es nach hartem Training an oder lasse es aus; stoppe bei Schmerz, Schwindel oder Unwohlsein. Es verhindert keinen Muskelkater, behandelt keine Verletzung und ersetzt keinen individuellen Rehaplan. Gezählt werden Bewegungen, Atemzüge oder Rollpassagen, keine Sekunden; Dauer wird nicht automatisch protokolliert.
